publication.policy_description: observed passing maneuver reserve and 3.0 V/cell pack floor

scope.controller_code: Actual compiled standard-motor, AM32 and official BLHeli_S code
scope.motor: Nonlinear magnetic B/H plant; table-calibrated Gemfan 1050 three-blade propeller fixture
scope.motor_parameters: Directly measured 640KV electrical parameters; modeled 800KV and 900KV rewinds
scope.FOC: 1 A injection target; dedicated field weakening off; MTPA and overmodulation retained
scope.comparison: Matched mission load and maneuver criterion within each winding/pack scenario; best tested AM32 and BLHeli_S settings selected by integrated mission duration

controller_gate.boundary_scope: Duration to lowest observed passing reserve SOC. Lower failed SOC bounds the actual capability threshold; no capability is claimed below the tested passing SOC.

observed_policy_pass.scope: Duration stops at an actually tested reserve point meeting physical thrust, selected loaded-cell voltage floor, and mission continuous-current policy. It does not claim the exact lower capability boundary. A0s interval when only full SOC is evidenced is missing endurance evidence, not predicted zero endurance.

pack_minimum_policy.reserve_voltage_crossing_scope: Piecewise-linear interpolation confined to measured native reserve voltage points; controller reserve qualification itself is never interpolated.
pack_minimum_policy.policy_scope: Loaded voltage floor enforced during both flight-power load and required reserve;128A continuous rating enforced at flight-power load. No reserve burst-current allowance is inferred.

observed_pack_minimum_policy.scope: Duration stops at an actually tested reserve point meeting physical thrust, selected loaded-cell voltage floor, and mission continuous-current policy. It does not claim the exact lower capability boundary. A0s interval when only full SOC is evidenced is missing endurance evidence, not predicted zero endurance.

selection.selection_rule: Among lower-S640KV/6S and900KV/4S configurations, greatest observed-pack-minimum-policy duration improvement over the strongest tested six-step setting at the same winding,pack,and reserve. Every controller stops at an actually tested reserve/voltage pass;900KV2.5-TWR capability tradeoff remains explicit.

replay.method: Piecewise-linear interpolation of actual native 1.5-TWR pack terminal power versus SOC; stable constant-power Thevenin current; charge integration from SOC1 to measured reserve pass SOC. Splits quadrature at native power and canonical OCV knots. Terminal power already includes four motors plus10W; no extra multiplication.
replay.scope: Illustrative equivalent steady-flight duration using1.5-TWR power, not a forward-flight aerodynamic model or measured aircraft endurance. Reserve gates retain battery sag from separate actual compiled reserve simulations.900KV uses2.5-TWR reserve,640/800KV use3-TWR reserve. No untested reserve SOC extrapolation.
replay.pack_policy_scope: Controller-capability duration and pack-policy duration are separate.3.0V/cell minimum and3.5V/cell recommended landing are explicit alternative policies, each applied to flight and reserve loaded voltage.128A continuous rating applies to mission power; reserve current above128A is flagged and no burst rating is assumed.
replay.loss_scope: Shared nonlinear motor/propeller fixture and native inverter/control losses are retained. Isothermal battery, synthetic OCV curve, constant5mOhm/cell and no polarization; no identified commercial pack discharge data.

validation.scope: SOC quadrature compared to independent time-domain stepping of the actual canonical C battery with identical measured power curves; source/load energy and54closed-form Ohm-law/load points also checked.

report.scope: Compact references to raw trace audits. Controller shortfalls remain physical outcomes; audit passed means identities and physics records agree, not that every controller case qualified.
